headlines.title: Lowe’s Just Paid Another Dividend. Its 64-Year Streak Is the Real Story
headlines.summary: Housing is stalling, guidance is shrinking, and buybacks have gone quiet. Yet one line item at Lowe's keeps climbing, and the size of next spring's raise could reveal how worried management really is.

headlines.title: Why Lowe's Companies (LOW) Moved And What Investors Are Weighing Now
headlines.summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) reset expectations after cutting its full-year 2026 sales outlook to about US$92b, putting extra focus on the upcoming third quarter report and trends in comparable sales. The reset in guidance has come against a sharp rebound in the Lowe's Companies share price, with a 1 month share price return of 27.79% and a 7 day share price return of 15.61%, even though the year to date share price return is down 7.

headlines.title: Guidance Cut Could Be A Big Test For Lowe's Stock (LOW)
headlines.summary: Lowe's Companies reduced its full-year 2026 sales and earnings outlook to about US$92b, citing softer consumer demand and persistent weakness in home building that is pressuring its builder oriented operations. Despite the lower guidance, management continues to point to solid momentum in Pro, Online, and Home Services. This highlights a business mix that depends less on do it yourself spending alone and more on diversified project based demand.

description: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and décor. In addition, it provides installation services through independent contractors in various product categories; and extended protection plans and repair services. Further, the company provides design, distribution, and installation services for interior surface finishes to home builders and property managers. It sells its national brand-name merchandise and private brand products to professional customers, individual homeowners, and renters. The company serves its products through Lowes.com website, mobile applications, retail home improvement stores and outlet stores, and its branches. Lowe's Companies, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is based in Mooresville, North Carolina.
